52228.author: stahlleiton
52228.body:
#### PR description:

This PR adds the slimmed negative secondary vertex collection in the PbPb MiniAOD through the pp_on_AA era modifier for a future rereco. To ensure that the negative secondary vertex producer uses the same settings as the standard one, the modifiers are moved to the source file (e.g. inclusiveCandidateVertexFinder_cfi.py). Checks done using 10k PbPb minbias events show only an increase in event size of 3.5% and timing of 2.5%.

@mandrenguyen

Tested with workflows 141.501,142.501,143.501,144.501,160.03,161.03,162.03,163.03

52245.author: stahlleiton
52245.body:
#### PR description:

This PR adds the option to keep the dEdx hit information based on a maximum number tracks passing a given selection. So far in the PbPb UPC reco, the dEdx hit information stored in the HIForward PDs is prescaled, and this PR allows the possibility to store it instead for most of ultra-peripheral collision events which yields low particle activity. The threshold of 50 tracks, set using the upc era modifier, was defined to cover most exclusive and inclusive processes in PbPb UPC while rejecting PbPb hadronic events.

@mandrenguyen

52272.author: cms-ngt-hlt
52272.body:
backport of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52264

#### PR description:

`HLTJetFlavourTagParticleTransformerSequencePF` contains a filter `hltPFJetForBtagSelector` (which is then just consumed by `hltPFJetForBtag` which is then not consumed by anything else).
This is an issue for the NGT menu where we want to run unfiltered. The solution is to extract `hltPFJetForBtagSelector` outside of `HLTJetFlavourTagParticleTransformerSequencePF` and remove the unused `hltPFJetForBtag`.
I profit of this PR to add a unit test `test_NGTScoutingL1GTAccept` to ensure that there are no other filters other than the one on the L1T global accept .

#### PR validation:

`scram b runtests_test_NGTScoutingL1GTAccept` runs.

52281.body:
backport of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52280

#### PR description:

This PR fixes two bugs:
- removes from `HLTrigger/Configuration/python/HLTrigger_EventContent_cff.py` the collections manually added in github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52124. Those are only relevant for Phase-2 and in this cycle as there is still active development on Run-3 they should not be added directly to the auto-generated file, but appended manually in `Configuration/EventContent/python/EventContent_cff.py`
- secondly, `getEventContent.py` is patched to deliver also the content of `hltOutputDQMTestDataScouting`  to the FEVT and DEBUG data-tiers, while avoiding duplication of the scouting collections in several derived data-tiers.

#### PR validation:

`getHLT.sh` with these changes runs.
